sections.title: Nature and the local environment: meaning and form
body: Goal: Understand environmental information and propose a realistic improvement for the local area.
Core vocabulary: återvinning, nedskräpning, hållbar. Key phrases: Glas sorteras separat. · Vi behöver färre engångsförpackningar. · Fler cykelställ skulle minska biltrafiken.

Use färre with countable plural nouns and mindre with uncountable quantities or degree. Use the passive when the action matters more than the actor: Glas sorteras separat. Connect a proposal to its effect with om or så att.
Say the examples aloud, notice the pattern, and then change one detail rather than memorising a fixed script.

sections.title: Register, evidence and independent use
body: Register model: “Tydligare skyltar skulle också hjälpa.” is a constructive proposal way to express “Clearer signs would also help.”.
For listening and reading, answer from a specific word or phrase. For speaking and writing, make the recipient, purpose and next action clear.
Attempt the task before using the model. Improve one high-impact feature, then perform it again with the transfer condition.

assignment.title: Four-skill task and transfer
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: First listen without a transcript. Answer: Which route can visitors use? Replay once and identify the exact words that prove the answer.

READ: Read for purpose and evidence. Answer: Where should residents continue taking glass and metal? Mark the shortest phrase that supports your choice.

SPEAK: Describe one environmental problem in your area, explain its cause or effect and propose two feasible actions. Make a first attempt, check clarity and repeat once.

WRITE: Write a 110-word message to the municipality about waste, traffic or a green space. Give evidence, propose a solution and explain the expected benefit. Check reader, purpose, required details and next action.

TRANSFER: The municipality can fund only one of your two actions; choose one and justify the priority.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: retrieve the three key phrases without looking, then use one in a new sentence.

takeaways: Notice: Use färre with countable plural nouns and mindre with uncountable quantities or degree.
